item.title: Mike Lee speaks on vote against bill preventing partial government shutdown
item.description: Senator Mike Lee (R-Utah) spoke on his decision to vote against a funding package involving six bills, after a partial government shutdown was narrowly avoided.

item.title: 'It has touched the lives of so many': High School Musical actor surprises East High School theater students
item.description: A group of East High School students got the surprise of their lives on Thursday when an actor from the High School Musical film franchise, walked into their theater rehearsal.

item.title: PHOTOS: A peek inside of Park City Fashion Week's show during the last Sundance in Utah
item.description: As the lights descended to a dim glow inside of the Black Rock Mountain Resort and the words "Park City Fashion Week" appeared on the stage, the excitement in the room was electric. Sundance is saying its goodbyes to Utah after the 2026 season and after five years running in conjunction with the festival, Park City Fashion Week (PCFW) returned to its grounds to take part in the sendoff.

item.title: Enterprise burger joint to close its doors after three decades
item.description: Marv's, a local burger joint, is closing its doors after thirty years of serving Enterprise and the Southern Utah community.

item.title: 'Turning pain into a purpose': Southern Utah woman opens up about surviving abuse and moving through the foster care system
item.description: At just 12 years old, Sherry Syson made a decision that changed everything, one that forced her to grow up fast and fight for a safer future for her family. Syson lost her mother at just three and a half years old. She spent time in foster care at five before being sent back home to live with her father. At 12, she advocated for herself and her siblings and reentered the system.

item.title: Lake Mountain School District swears in new superintendent
item.description: The third and final school district replacing Alpine School District in 2027 has chosen a new superintendent.

item.title: 'Bonded by blood, sweat, tears': Utah nurses hold vigil for Minneapolis man killed by ICE
item.description: On Thursday evening, Utah nurses and residents gathered to honor Alex Pretti, who was shot and killed by an officer with United States Immigrations and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Minneapolis.

item.title: Several Utah businesses set to close Friday amid Anti-ICE 'National Shutdown' protest
item.description: As several state leaders on both sides of the political aisle call for a thorough investigation into the fatal U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement shooting of 37-year-old Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, an Anti-Ice protest dubbed "national shutdown" is scheduled for Friday across the country.

item.title: Open house held for Santaquin data center; some residents feel blindsided
item.description: Summit Ridge Data Center held an open house Thursday to answer questions about the data center being built in the Summit Ridge area of Santaquin.

item.title: Rural Utah faces old water infrastructure, water supply issues, during fires
item.description: As Utah's rural population grows, some officials say crews are having to fight fires without fire hydrants.
